candidates: In YAML code snippets within documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow examples under `docs/_snippets/`), separate each top-level key (`name`, `on`, `permissions`, `concurrency`, `jobs`, etc.) with a blank line, and also add blank lines between major sub-blocks within a job definition (e.g., between `environment` and `steps`). This improves readability and makes the snippet easier to audit.
